rapport_notes: Chauntelle is warm, personable, and responsive; good pacing and reassurance throughout, though some repetition in explanations.
process_discipline_notes: Rep did not hold silence after 'does that work?' or the close; transitioned immediately to booking confirmation without allowing customer space to reflect or object.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Partial framing: 'So what we'll do is kind of I already have the foundational information here. I'll kind of run through so that you can confirm if the addresses are correct and then we'll kind of get everything set up and then I'll clarify some information and then I can get you that customized estimate.' — promise of quote present, but no explicit time-box or trade framing ('take about X minutes').
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked before probing: 'And before I kind of dive in too far, did you have just any top of mind important questions that you would like me to kind of answer right off the top.' Customer responds: 'No, I just wanted to like get more color on how the process is and how to go from here. Basically, I have never like hired more and like backers before.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No follow-up layering observed. Customer raises concern ('I've never hired movers before'), rep acknowledges but pivots immediately to logistics confirmation ('So I do have us moving you from 2732...') without probing 'tell me more about that' or 'what else is on your list.'
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Never asked or answered. No mention of damage coverage, 'what to be careful with,' or the '$2,000 coverage' differentiator.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Never asked or answered. No mention of 'Meet Your Mover,' named crew lead, or who will show up.
evidence_quotes.communication: Never mentioned anywhere in call. No day-before call, no crew-lead name, no inbox updates.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor with personalization: 'Our range for a move for a one bedroom apartment for this, which is typically is two and a half to three and a half hours, like, typically but that's without any packing.' Then personalized: 'because the square footage that I have for this department is 550...because of the square footage, I mean, I would expect for to take less than that six to seven hours.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Rep explained: 'if you opt to do the full packing service then what we, what we would be looking at is about six to seven hours' and 'if the whole move doesn't take the six to seven hours, and it does take less hours. You'll only pay for the hours used' — establishes the window logic.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Covered: 'if the whole move doesn't take the six to seven hours, and it does take less hours. You'll only pay for the hours used' and 'if they get finished with everything then you know, less than what we estimated then, then great.'
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Never mentioned. No reference to customer prep reducing billable time.
evidence_quotes.commit_to_rate: Not stated. Rep did not use experience framing (100k moves) or explicitly commit to the rate quoted.
evidence_quotes.does_that_feel_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'does that feel fair?' Rep transitioned directly to booking: 'Absolutely, so there's no, there's no charge to book...we do have availability for tomorrow.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock: Never mentioned. Rep did not state 'your rate locks when you book.'
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Implied booking ask ('if you want me to go ahead and get that booking confirmed for you I can go ahead and confirm it right now') but not a direct close line like 'would you like our help with your move?' No formal closing sequence.

top_strength: Chauntelle successfully anchored the estimate with both a typical range for one-bedroom moves and specific personalization based on square footage (550 sq ft), then clearly explained the 'pay for hours used' window logic, which directly addresses a key customer concern about flexibility.
coaching_note: The call skipped the entire 'ramp-up, take away' stage — never asked about carefulness/damage concerns or who's showing up, and never delivered the On-Time Guarantee or Communication differentiators; add 'tell me more' follow-ups to the agenda opener, and front-load the two most relevant differentiators (damage coverage and crew lead) as direct answers to customer concerns before moving to booking.
